clips.text: Seven thousand years ago, someone in Europe drank a full cup of fresh milk — and nothing happened. No cramps. No sickness. Nothing.
Everyone else in the village got sick from the same cup. Same milk, same clay, same morning — different bodies.
The healers checked the milk. They checked the cup. They checked the goat. Nothing was wrong with any of them.
So they looked closer — at the drinker. And inside that one person, they found something no one had ever seen before.
That something is still inside some of us today. It decides whether milk is food — or a stomach-ache.
What did they find? The full story is on Ghazi What If — and the test is in the long video.
